newsitem.title: UK: Gehe has 98 pct of Lloyds Chemists.
newsitem.headline: Gehe has 98 pct of Lloyds Chemists.

text.p: German drugs group Gehe AG said on Friday it had commitments for about 98 percent of the ordinary share capital of British chemists chain Lloyds Chemists Plc.
The company's 525p offer for Lloyds would remain open until further notice, Gehe said in a statement.
As of 1300 GMT, the firm's Gehe Invest unit had received valid acceptances covering 25.16 million Lloyds shares, representing some 19.9 percent of the share capital.
In addition, Gehe Invest had acquired or agreed to acquire 98.77 million shares, or 78.15 percent.
Gehe clinched its year-long fight for Lloyds earlier this month after outgunning Britain's Unichem Plc, with a bid worth about 684 million stg.
